name: spec-anchored
description: Spec-anchored agentic development: one permanent spec per capability, machine gates before human review, and autonomy only with evidence. Harness-neutral operational layer.

author.name: Local adaptation of Raphael Moura's spec-anchored method

interface.shortDescription: One permanent spec per capability, with machine gates before human review.
interface.longDescription: Spec-anchored agentic development for Codex. Shared skills, agents, and templates live in lib/. This manifest is the Codex format. The plugin collects no data.
defaultPrompt: Shape the next capability before writing a spec.
Implement one ratified spec slice and stop when the pull request is ready for a human.
